safety.title: ORCA SAFETY ASSESSMENT
safety.subtitle: Deterministic Marine Safety Decision & Risk Evidence
safety.altStorm: Delay departure until active severe convective storm warnings in the sector have cleared.
safety.altWave: Delay departure until significant wave heights subside below unsafe operating thresholds.
safety.altWind: Postpone departure until sustained wind speeds subside below unsafe operating thresholds.
safety.altRestricted: Adjust navigational route to remain outside the restricted boundary perimeter before commencing operations.
safety.altHarbor: Delay departure and remain in harbor until updated coastal forecasts indicate safe conditions.
safety.altBuffer: Maintain safe navigational distance outside the restricted boundary buffer.
safety.altMonitor: Monitor continuous marine meteorological broadcasts and exercise heightened vigilance.
safety.altAcceptable: Conditions are acceptable. Maintain standard navigational vigilance and monitor routine marine weather updates.
safety.dirUnsafe: Generic Safety Notice: Sea conditions evaluated as unsafe. Follow coastal maritime safety authority instructions.
safety.dirCaution: Generic Safety Notice: Marginal marine conditions observed. Exercise heightened vigilance.
safety.dirSafe: Generic Safety Notice: Marine conditions evaluated as acceptable for normal operations.
